envelope.description: Send only the latest window on restore

body.title: Send only the latest window on restore
body.summary: Switch postInitialState, the new-chat handler and the open-chat handler to post session-restored through one helper that uses latestWindow, so only the latest window is sent with its firstIndex and total. Update the tests that assert the whole transcript is posted.
acceptanceChecks: Opening a 1,000-row session posts at most 200 rows, firstIndex at a turn start, total 1,000 and the session's mode; a short session is posted whole with firstIndex 0
ready, new-chat and open-chat post the same windowed session-restored
A `ready` after older pages were requested posts the latest window again, with the approval head after it
After restores and page loads the saved transcript equals the original rows

tests.name: opening a 1,000-row session posts session-restored with at most 200 rows, firstIndex at a turn start, total 1,000 and the session's mode; a short session is posted whole with firstIndex 0
ready, new-chat and open-chat post the same windowed session-restored
a ready after older pages were requested posts the latest window again, with the approval head after it
the stored session is unchanged by paging: after restores and page loads the saved transcript equals the original rows
